question: Should this PR require real Feishu Open Platform proof before merge, or may maintainers accept the mocked-client proof for this media fallback fix?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-backed, but repository policy treats external API/channel delivery changes as needing real behavior proof unless a maintainer intentionally waives that gap.

options.title: Require live Feishu proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted live output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording proves image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal in a real Feishu setup.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can merge based on the helper reuse and focused tests while explicitly owning the remaining live transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until redacted live output, logs, terminal output, or a short recording proves image/file fallback delivery and unsafe native-thread refusal in a real Feishu setup.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged fallback helper and adjacent Feishu withdrawn-target behavior that this PR extends.
